text:
finance: Heads up — today we're launching a new pricing change that affects how burst and route-level quotas are metered. TL;DR: per-route dynamic rate limits + a shared developer credits pool (beta). Grandfathering window: 60 days for existing customers. See details below.

sam-engineering: quick q — what's "per-route dynamic" mean for apps that fan-out to multiple models?

finance: good Q. It means rate limits can now be applied per API route + model variant; requests will be metered against that route's quota first, then fall back to a shared org pool if configured. Purpose is to avoid noisy neighbors on critical routes.

maya-product: this includes a Console UI preview, right? we should add a banner for users in the beta orgs.

finance: yes — Console will show an "Invoice Preview" and a live quota map. Beta rollout starts next week for orgs opted into "flex-pool". Banner will appear for admins only.

elena-ops: any changes to overage billing math? we had customers ask about per-minute vs per-second rounding.

finance: overages now billed at per-second granularity for all generation calls (reduces rounding overhead). Embedding and batch endpoints keep per-token billing. This change reduces unexpected micro-overages.

billings-bot: AUTOMATED NOTICE: Transition timeline:
- Day 0: Announcement (today)
- Day 7: Opt-in beta for flex-pool / invoice preview
- Day 60: Default enforcement for new orgs; existing customers retained under previous rules unless they opt-in
- Day 120: Full cutover for billing engine (non-destructive, with invoice diff reports)

ryan-sales: can we surface a simple example in the support doc? like a small org with 2 routes, where one route has 90% of traffic and we show cost difference. Sales deck needs that.

finance: yes — we'll add a "before/after" worked example + sample invoice diffs to the docs repo. cc @nathan-cto for tech note on how billing ties to routing.

nathan-cto: flag: make sure Dedicated customers with pinned capacity aren't affected by shared pool unless explicitly enabled. We'll add an explicit `shared_pool: false` default for Dedicated plans.

sam-engineering: for the SDKs, do we need new headers to mark route usage, or is it inferred from path?

finance: SDKs will send optional header `x-rw-route-id` for explicit mapping; if absent, we infer from request path. We'll publish client updates (minor semver) and keep server-side inference for backward compatibility.

maya-product: can we get a short blurb for the public changelog? avoid deep billing math but highlight: per-route controls, shared dev credits, invoice preview beta, 60-day grandfathering.

finance: yep — drafting the public changelog now. Internal docs (billing playbook) will have the full timelines and migration checklist.

elena-ops: ops note — add a monitoring alert for "unexpected pool drain" that pings #support if org pool usage > 80% in 15m.

billing-bot: ACTION CREATED: alert rule `flex-pool-drain` in prod (owner: eng-sre).

ryan-sales: :party: good work — let's also schedule a short webinar for customers on the new tool set.

finance: will do. If anyone needs the draft doc link or wants to be on the customer webinar panel, DM me.

sam-engineering: thanks. small request — include an example `curl` showing `x-rw-route-id` so SDK folks can test.

finance: adding now:
```bash
curl -X POST \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \ 
  -H "x-rw-route-id: checkout-confirmation" \ 
  -d '{"input":"..."}' \ 
  https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate
```

maya-product: :eyes: looks good.

finance: End of thread — we'll post the full migration checklist and doc links in #product-updates once they're live. Thanks everyone!
